Entries.Title: Spider-Man
Entries.Description: Peter Parker and his college science professor Dr. Curt Conners explore neogenics as a method of limb regeneration. But while experimenting on himself, Connors accidentally becomes the Lizard, a half-man, half-reptile monstrosity that terrorizes Manhattan and subsequently kidnaps his own wife. Spider-Man must stop the Lizard, but his task is doubly difficult because he doesn't want to hurt the good friend he knows is trapped inside.

Episodes.Title: Night of the Lizard
Episodes.Description: Peter Parker and his college science professor Dr. Curt Conners explore neogenics as a method of limb regeneration. But while experimenting on himself, Connors accidentally becomes the Lizard, a half-man, half-reptile monstrosity that terrorizes Manhattan and subsequently kidnaps his own wife. Spider-Man must stop the Lizard, but his task is doubly difficult because he doesn't want to hurt the good friend he knows is trapped inside.

Episodes.Title: The Spider Slayer (1)
Episodes.Description: Norman Osborn hires Spencer Smythe to design a machine capable of destroying Spider-Man—the Black Widow Spider Slayer. But when Flash Thompson puts on a Spider-Man costume as a party gag, the deadly machine spots him, and he's carried off in Peter's place.

Episodes.Title: Return of the Spider Slayers (2)
Episodes.Description: With Spencer Smythe dead, his son Alistair turns to the Kingpin to help seek his revenge on Spider-Man and others he deems responsible for his father's death. He captures Eddie Brock, J. Jonah Jameson, Norman Osborn, and Flash Thompson. He then turns his sights on Spider-Man and sends three slayers after him. Spider-Man only manages to hold his ground while fighting them individually. However, he is not so lucky when they combine into a super slayer and carry him off to Smythe.

Episodes.Title: Doctor Octopus: Armed and Dangerous
Episodes.Description: Dr. Otto Octavius becomes the mad Dr. Octopus when his robotic arms become fused to him in a laboratory accident. He then seeks revenge for the humiliation the Hardy Foundation has caused him, so he kidnaps Felicia Hardy and holds her ransom.

Episodes.Title: The Menace of Mysterio
Episodes.Description: The Master of Illusion, Mysterio has fooled the city and J. Jonah Jameson into thinking Spider-Man has turned to crime. However, Spider-Man manages to find Mysterio, only to be brought to a trap of special effects.

Episodes.Title: The Sting of the Scorpion
Episodes.Description: J. Jonah Jameson hires Dr. Farley Stillwell, a genius in genetic engineering, to make a new superhero that can match and defeat Spider-Man. With a willing participant, Mac Gargain, they engineer the DNA of a scorpion and him together to form a new hero, the Scorpion. However, when Gargain thinks they have turned him into a freak, the hero turns into a monster and goes on a rampage. Spider-Man is forced to step in to stop the creation from killing its creator.

Episodes.Title: Kraven the Hunter
Episodes.Description: Robbie has set Peter up with a job interview with a researcher by the name of Dr. Mariah Crawford. However, when he gets to her lab, he finds her under attack by a monstrous man who deems himself Kraven the Hunter. Spider-Man leads Crawford away from Kraven to the roofs. There, Crawford tells Spider-Man that Kraven was not always that way, that in fact she loved him as Sergei Kravenoff. Crawford tells of an accident years back that would have killed Sergei had she not used a dangerous potion that saved his life and gave him the strength and instinct of an animal, but turned him mad. Meanwhile, while looking for Crawford at her apartment, Kraven learns of her connection to Robbie and kidnaps him. He then threatens to kill Robbie if Spider-Man does not come to him with Crawford.

Episodes.Title: The Alien Costume (1)
Episodes.Description: A space shuttle piloted by J.J.'s son, John Jameson, crash lands on the Tri-Borough Bridge carrying two strange meteors—one that could provide a new nuclear fuel and one that contains an alien substance. The first is stolen by the Kingpin's henchman, the Rhino, just as Spider-Man arrives to save Jameson and the co-pilots. When the Rhino sends the aircraft off the bridge, Spider-Man emerges from the water with a dark stain covering his costume. Exhausted, he heads for home, only to awaken hanging from a skyscraper, now clothed in a black version of his costume.

Episodes.Title: The Alien Costume (2)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man goes after Eddie Brock for libeling him, as he is now being stalked by bounty hunters at every turn. After being reassured by Mary Jane that he has changed, he seeks help from Dr. Curt Connors who discovers that the suit is alive, and Peter is the host organism.

Episodes.Title: The Alien Costume (3)
Episodes.Description: The Kingpin is furious at Spider-Man and sends the Shocker and the Rhino out to finish him off with the aid of another new invention of Alistair Smythe. Meanwhile, Eddie Brock, as the symbiote creature Venom, is busy playing cat and mouse with Spider-Man, intruding on Peter's private life and making it clear he knows the web-slinger's secret identity. To make matters worse, Peter soon realizes that the pumped-up Eddie as Venom is stronger than he is.

Episodes.Title: The Hobgoblin (1)
Episodes.Description: Norman Osborn hires the Hobgoblin, a hitman and thief, to take out Osborn's "silent" partner Wilson Fisk, the Kingpin. When he fails in the attempt, the Hobgoblin changes sides, kidnapping Norman's son, Harry. Harry just happens to be best friends with Peter Parker.

Episodes.Title: The Hobgoblin (2)
Episodes.Description: When Aunt May is slightly injured by one of the Hobgoblin's pumpkin bombs during the kidnapping of Harry, Spider-Man enters the fray with a vengeance. After several battles, the trail leads Peter to Oscorp and Harry's own father. For Peter, rescuing his friend is easy compared to explaining to Harry that his own father is involved.

Episodes.Title: Day of the Chameleon
Episodes.Description: An international spy and hitman known as the Chameleon plans to assassinate two major diplomats on the brink of signing the peace proposal of the century. S.H.I.E.L.D. director Nick Fury solicits J. Jonah Jameson's assistance in an effort to prevent the "human shape-shifter" from derailing the proposal signing. But only Spider-Man with his super keen "spider-sense" can discern who is really whom and stop the criminal before it's too late.

Episodes.Title: The Power of Dr. Octopus
Episodes.Description: Teenage photographer Peter Parker is sent by the Daily Bugle to investigate a series of mystery lights in a wooded area outside of the city, when a sudden landslide forces him to swerve off the road and land in a tree.

Episodes.Title: Sub-Zero for Spidey
Episodes.Description: On a blistering hot afternoon, Peter is walking to the house of a brilliant scientist, Doctor Smartyr, when suddenly he notices that the sidewalk, and most of the neighborhood, is turning to ice. Hearing desperate cries for help from Smartyr's house, Peter changes into Spider-Man and breaks through a laboratory window to find the frightened scientist being menaced by a towering ice creature.

Episodes.Title: Where Crawls the Lizard
Episodes.Description: Peter flies to Florida to find and photograph the Lizard Man. Spider-Man meets Dr. Curtis Connor's family. He is pulled underwater by the Lizard Man, but escapes.

Episodes.Title: Electro, the Human Lightning Bolt
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man is set up numerous times by Electro's robberies.

Episodes.Title: The Menace of Mysterio
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man has been witnessed committing a robbery of the Midtown Museum.

Episodes.Title: The Sky Is Falling
Episodes.Description: The Vulture uses a sonic device in his head mask to control an army of vultures. After the Vulture beats Spider-Man, he holds the city up for a $2,000,000 ransom and J. Jonah Jameson blames Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: Captured by J. Jonah Jameson
Episodes.Description: An inventor named Henry Smythe reveals his plans to capture Spider-Man with a robot and get paid by J. Jonah Jameson for his efforts.

Episodes.Title: Never Step on a Scorpion
Episodes.Description: Dr. Stillwell creates the Scorpion on J. Jonah Jameson's behalf to capture Spider-Man. The Scorpion attacks Spider-Man, who escapes. However, the Scorpion's evil nature takes over as his strength increases which causes him to go after Jameson.

Episodes.Title: Sands of Crime
Episodes.Description: As Spider-Man examines the Goliath Diamond, the Sandman appears and swipes the diamond, with Spider-Man getting the blame as he is seen by the guards.

Episodes.Title: Diet of Destruction
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man witnesses, and photographs, a giant metal-eating robot in Central Park.

Episodes.Title: The Witching Hour
Episodes.Description: The Green Goblin swipes Grandini the Mystic's witchcraft book, hoping to control demons of the Underworld.

Episodes.Title: Kilowatt Kaper
Episodes.Description: Electro escapes prison, before Spider-Man can stop him, using a metal kite during an electrical storm to renew his powers.

Episodes.Title: The Peril of Parafino
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man faces off against Parafino, a wax museum owner who plans to make Spider-Man into his latest exhibit.

Episodes.Title: Horn of the Rhino
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man is keeping an eye on a train when the Rhino rams into it and steals the first component of a top secret weapon.

Episodes.Title: The One-Eyed Idol
Episodes.Description: Someone has sent a one-eyed idol to J. Jonah Jameson. Jameson is hypnotized by the idol to steal his own money. Spider-Man finds the thief, but he escapes with the money.

Episodes.Title: Fifth Avenue Phantom
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man attempts to halt the Phantom's activities only to be set up by him and his robot henchwoman Marie, who is disguised as a shop window mannequin.

Episodes.Title: The Revenge of Dr. Magneto
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man saves a boat from Dr. Matto Magneto's attempt to crash it on the rocks by sabotaging a lighthouse.

Episodes.Title: The Sinister Prime Minister
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man gets into an embassy, sees the foreign visiting Prime Minister tied up and gagged, and fights someone impersonating the Prime Minister, but he is forced to retreat to find proof after being gassed by the imposter's cane and having his camera stolen.

Episodes.Title: The Night of the Villains
Episodes.Description: Historic villains Blackbeard the Pirate, Jesse James, and the Executioner of Paris are committing robberies in New York City.

Episodes.Title: Here Comes Trubble
Episodes.Description: Miss Trubble, a book dealer obsessed with mythology, is owner of a magical chest from which she summons a succession of mythological figures, from centaurs to the Cyclops to Diana the Hunter-Goddess, to commit robberies of ancient artifacts on her behalf.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Man Meets Doctor Noah Boddy
Episodes.Description: A scientist, Dr. Noah Boddy, renders himself invisible by means of a machine, then acts to avenge himself upon Jameson, who publically maligned his theory of invisibility.

Episodes.Title: The Fantastic Fakir
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man battles an Arabian jewel thief, whose magical flute induces animals into attacking Spidey.

Episodes.Title: Return of the Flying Dutchman
Episodes.Description: Reports of a legendary flying ghost ship, the Flying Dutchman, being sighted near Smuggler's Cove summon Spidey to the area, where his investigation into the phantom ship's appearance leads him to a cave in which he finds his sworn adversary, Mysterio, plotting with a pair of thugs.

Episodes.Title: Farewell Performance
Episodes.Description: When a Jekyll-and-Hyde poster comes to life at the soon-to-be-demolished Castle Theatre, Spidey visits the theatre and encounters mischievous Blackwell the Magician, who is trying to attract public attention to the theatre in hope of preventing its demolition.

Episodes.Title: The Golden Rhino
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man's old enemy, the rampaging Rhino, is stealing gold bullion to mold an auric likeness of himself.

Episodes.Title: Blueprint for Crime
Episodes.Description: A bald-headed mastermind, the Plotter, employs two ridiculous criminals, Cowboy and Ox, to steal a blueprint to a missile.

Episodes.Title: The Spider and the Fly
Episodes.Description: Spidey chases the culprit in an attempted theft of jewels from a countess and is surprised to find that his opponent, dressed in a black Human Fly costume, also has the ability to scale walls and can cross thin wires between buildings.

Episodes.Title: The Slippery Doctor Von Schlick
Episodes.Description: Oil is being stolen in huge quantities by Dr. Von Schlick, a chemist villain garbed in a rubber, non-stick suit and armed with petroleum-based bubbles that he fires from his fingers.

Episodes.Title: The Vulture's Prey
Episodes.Description: The nefarious Vulture traps Jameson inside of a tower-clock and uses the well-informed Daily Bugle publisher as a source of information on the whereabouts of a visiting diamond merchant and the testing of military equipment—two prospective heists for the greedy bird-man.

Episodes.Title: The Dark Terrors
Episodes.Description: Life-like and substantial shadows of beasts are projected in various locations in New York City by the Phantom's new Shadow-Scope glasses to cause panic and enable the Phantom to effect unconstrained bank and jewelry store robberies.

Episodes.Title: The Terrible Triumph of Dr. Octopus
Episodes.Description: Doctor Octopus imposes upon Dr. Smartyr's Nullifier rocket test and steals the ultra-powerful destructor missile.

Episodes.Title: Magic Malice
Episodes.Description: While Blackwell the Magician is entertaining at the Castle Theatre, his house is invaded by the Green Goblin, who swipes some of Blackwell's props and peruses Blackwell's book of magic spells and incantations.

Episodes.Title: Fountain of Terror
Episodes.Description: Dr. Curtis Conner goes missing in the Florida swamps after finding the Fountain of Youth. When Spidey investigates the scientist's disappearance, he discovers a fifteenth century Spanish conquistador, Ponce de León, who is intent upon keeping the magical fountain a secret.

Episodes.Title: Fiddler on the Loose
Episodes.Description: Because he hates rock-and-roll for its having replaced classical music in the tastes of the masses, a fiddler with a deadly, sonic violin seeks revenge upon pop-music sponsor Cyrus Flintridge.

Episodes.Title: To Catch a Spider
Episodes.Description: Under the guidance of Dr. Noah Boddy, the Green Goblin, Electro, and the Vulture join forces for revenge on Spiderman.

Episodes.Title: Double Identity
Episodes.Description: Art robberies are committed by an old enemy of Spider-Man, actor Charles Cameo, who can utilize masks and make-up to usurp any identity, including those of J. Jonah Jameson and Spiderman!

Episodes.Title: Sting of the Scorpion
Episodes.Description: When the Scorpion, intent on vengeance upon Spider-Man and Jameson, escapes prison, he visits the laboratory of his creator, Dr. Stillwell, and drinks a potion that vastly increases his size.

Episodes.Title: Trick or Treachery
Episodes.Description: Paroled from prison, the Human Fly Twins rob diamonds from an importing company, and one of them does this deed in a Spider-Man costume so that the guard, before being hit on the head from behind by the second twin, believes that Spidey is the culprit.

Episodes.Title: Bubble, Bubble, Oil and Trouble
Episodes.Description: Dr. Octopus commits mysterious crimes to steal the world’s oil supply.

Episodes.Title: Dr. Doom, Master of the World
Episodes.Description: Dr. Doom is mind-controlling world leaders to become master of the world.

Episodes.Title: Lizards, Lizards, Everywhere
Episodes.Description: The Lizard plots to turn NYC into a swampland with reptiles.

Episodes.Title: Curiosity Killed the Spider-Man
Episodes.Description: The Black Cat has plans to steal the Maltese Mouse & challenges Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman Is Coming
Episodes.Description: The Sandman steals a soil sample from Mars from NASA.

Episodes.Title: When Magneto Speaks.... People Listen
Episodes.Description: Magneto uses a spacecraft to increase his powers & shut the power supply.

Episodes.Title: The Pied Piper of New York Town
Episodes.Description: Mysterio opens a nightclub that turns its patrons into slaves.

Episodes.Title: The Doctor Prescribes Doom
Episodes.Description: Dr. Doom returns to replace the world leaders with robots to rule the world.

Episodes.Title: Carnival of Crime
Episodes.Description: The circus comes & the Ringmaster uses gas to rob banks & frame Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: Revenge of the Green Goblin
Episodes.Description: Norman Osborn escapes from a hospital & remembers he's the Green Goblin.

Episodes.Title: Triangle of Evil
Episodes.Description: Triangle of Evil led by Stuntman forces Spider-Man to survive deadly stunts.

Episodes.Title: The A-B-C's of D-O-O-M
Episodes.Description: Dr. Doom forms a criminal partnership with Goron.

Episodes.Title: The Sidewinder Strikes!
Episodes.Description: A rodeo has come to the city & the Sidewinder tries to steal gold spurs.

Episodes.Title: The Hunter and the Hunted
Episodes.Description: Kraven the Hunter comes to the city as a hero when he captures Zabu.

Episodes.Title: The Incredible Shrinking Spider-Man
Episodes.Description: A janitor dons the identity of the Gadgeteer to steal his employer’s device.

Episodes.Title: The Unfathomable Professor Gizmo
Episodes.Description: Professor Gizmo seeks to reclaim sunken treasure & steal diamonds.

Episodes.Title: Canon of Doom
Episodes.Description: Dr. Doom uses a laser cannon to create a fault line on NYC.

Episodes.Title: The Capture of Captain America
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man tries to save Captain America after he's kidnapped by the Red Skull.

Episodes.Title: The Doom Report
Episodes.Description: Freedom fighters start an underground movement in NYC.

Episodes.Title: The Web of Nephilia
Episodes.Description: Dr. Bradley Shaw transforms into a mutant spider.

Episodes.Title: Countdown to Doom
Episodes.Description: NASA sends a rocket into space, built by Doctor Doom, unaware of his plan.

Episodes.Title: Arsenic and Aunt May
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man catches the relative of the burglar that killed his uncle.

Episodes.Title: The Vulture Has Landed
Episodes.Description: The Vulture kidnaps scientists to gain control of a NASA space probe.

Episodes.Title: Wrath of the Sub-Mariner
Episodes.Description: Kingpin shows crime boss Silvermane a powerful acid developed by his scientist, Dr. Everett.

Episodes.Title: The Return of Kingpin
Episodes.Description: The Kingpin is able to trick Spider-Man into committing a series of crimes.

Episodes.Title: Under the Wizard's Spell
Episodes.Description: The Wizard invites Medusa to New York City to steal a device from the military.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: The Insidious Six
Episodes.Description: The Crime Lords, led by Silvermane, are holding the Kingpin accountable for his failure to eliminate Spider-Man. So six of the wall-crawler's greatest enemies are called together to do the job: Doctor Octopus, Mysterio, the Scorpion, the Rhino, the Shocker and the Chameleon. Unfortunately, Spidey's powers have been on the blink due to the changes in his blood chemistry.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: Battle of the Insidious Six
Episodes.Description: The six supervillains can't believe their eyes when Spider-Man walks into their trap at the warehouse. But it's obvious why, when they easily overcome and unmask the fraud. Meanwhile, Silvermane and the Crime Lords grow more disenchanted with the Kingpin and want to put him out of business. However, Kingpin beats them to the punch, kidnapping Silvermane.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: Hydro-Man
Episodes.Description: Mary Jane is being stalked by her former boyfriend, Morris Bench, who's undergone an accidental metamorphosis and become Hydro-Man. Sweeping Mary Jane off her feet in a wave of water, he insists she will love him. Spider-Man, with the help of Mary Jane, must put a stop to the semi-liquid villain.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: The Mutant Agenda
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man's progressing neogenic mutation is making him ill and he seeks the aid of a man known to help all mutants, Dr. Charles Xavier. In doing so he meets the X-Men, but is disappointed to learn that Xavier does not 'cure' mutancy, only helps those born that way to accept and control their abilities. In the process of this endeavor he becomes involved in a plot to destroy mutants everywhere, and must stop this hideous plan with the help of the X-Men.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: Mutants' Revenge
Episodes.Description: Wolverine catches up with Spider-Man, hot on the trail of the missing Hank McCoy. Discovering his location and the plot to destroy all mutantkind the two team up and rescue Beast in the nick of time just as he was about to become the first test subject of Landon's horrendous plan. But when Landon accidentally falls victim to his own experiment he is changed into a giant monster that feeds on electrical energy.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: Morbius
Episodes.Description: Dr. Mariah Crawford has developed a cure for Spider-Man's disease, but she is reluctant to give an untested serum to him that may result in permanent loss of his powers or worse. After an angry outburst from Spider-Man, however, she hands it over. Peter, at the ESU lab, is secretly observed by Michael Morbius, who then swipes the infected blood sample after Peter leaves for the night. Working alone in the campus bell tower with borrowed equipment, Morbius has an accident which will change him forever.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: Enter the Punisher
Episodes.Description: The Punisher comes to New York to deal with the mutating Spider-Man, who has just grown four extra arms, and is in search for also mutated Morbius who is killing innocent people, and the people of New York blame Spider-Man for all that is happening.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: Duel of the Hunters
Episodes.Description: After Spider-Man mutates into the Man-Spider, Dr. Mariah Crawford summons Sergi Kravenoff, better known as Kraven the Hunter, to help her track down Spider-Man and cure him of his mutation with a newly developed antidote. Unfortunately, the Punisher is hot on Spider-Man's heels.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: Blade the Vampire Hunter
Episodes.Description: The vampire hunter Blade arrives in New York to destroy Morbius, but Spider-Man wants to revert Morbius back into his human form.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: The Immortal Vampire
Episodes.Description: Morbius attempts to use the Neogenic Recombinator to turn everyone else into a vampire. Spider-Man and Blade try to stop him, and Morbius' mutation worsens. Morbius kidnaps Felicia Hardy in order to transform her into a vampire.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: Tablet of Time
Episodes.Description: Dr. Curt Connors is set to study the Tablet of Time, a recently discovered ancient artifact that is said to restore a person's youth. Dr. Connors believes he can cure Spider-Man's mutagenic transformations with the tablet.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: Ravages of Time
Episodes.Description: With the Tablet of Time, Silvermane's youth is restored, but he continues to grow younger until he finally becomes an infant.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: Shriek of the Vulture
Episodes.Description: Adrian Toomes wants revenge when Norman Osborn attempts to take over his company, Toomes Aeronautical. He becomes the Vulture and immediately kidnaps Norman's son, Harry.

Episodes.Title: Neogenic Nightmare: The Final Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man seeks Curt Connors' aid to help reverse the aging effects of the Vulture's talons. Meanwhile, the Vulture sporadically turns into the man-spider from the mutagenics he absorbed with Spider-Man's youth. At the same time, the Scorpion grabs Dr. Farley Stillwell to seek a cure for his own mutation, while Connors is feeling the onset of his reptilian transformation.

Episodes.Title: The Origin of Spiderman
Episodes.Description: Student Peter Parker is labeled a "bookworm" by his peers when he declines their offer of a triple-date in favor of viewing a radiology experiment.

Episodes.Title: King Pinned
Episodes.Description: On his first night at work at the Daily Bugle, Peter overhears talk of a fake medicine racket engineered by a rotund mobster called the Kingpin.

Episodes.Title: Swing City
Episodes.Description: A twisted radiation specialist gains illicit dominion over Manhattan's new and only nuclear power plant and uses a special ray to lift Manhattan into the clouds.

Episodes.Title: Criminals in the Clouds
Episodes.Description: Roy Robinson, star football player, campus ladies' man, son of a wealthy chemical industrialist, is envied by Peter, who decides to use his spider-power to play football and outperform Robinson.

Episodes.Title: Menace from the Bottom of the World
Episodes.Description: Investigating the disappearance of banks, Spidey finds a hole that leads to a maze of underground tunnels, through which Spidey undertakes a perilous journey in search of the lost occupants of the submerged banks.

Episodes.Title: Diamond Dust
Episodes.Description: A baseball diamond and the spherical, baseball-sized Optimo Diamond at the Cosmopolitan Museum are connected in this episode.

Episodes.Title: Spiderman Battles the Molemen
Episodes.Description: Mugs Riley, evidently escaped from prison, has duped the Molemen into following him again.

Episodes.Title: Phantom from the Depths of Time
Episodes.Description: Giant, mechanical beetles are used by Manta to capture and enslave the peace-loving inhabitants of an island to mine a valuable ore.

Episodes.Title: The Evil Sorcerer
Episodes.Description: In ancient Egypt, one of the most aggressive of evil magicians, Kotep, the Scarlet Sorcerer, is defeated in battle with an opponent, and his own demons strike him with a cursing ball of fire that puts him in suspended animation, his mummified remains lasting through the passing centuries and becoming an exhibit at a New York university and the object of a professor's obsession.

Episodes.Title: Vine
Episodes.Description: A giant plant escapes from storage in a house belonging to Prof. Smithers, a missing scientist. Spidey goes through a portal (located in the scientist's home) to prehistoric times to find some defense against the plant and meets Smithers, who tells to him that two radium gems in an idol in a nearby city, if ingested by the plant in New York, will disintegrate it.

Episodes.Title: Pardo Presents
Episodes.Description: Pardo is a sorcerer with the ability to transform himself into a giant cat with hypnotic eyes. He lures top New York City’s citizens and officials to a theatre with the promise of a spectacular show, then releases his feline alter-ego's power upon the hapless audience, intending to divest them of their wealth and sap the souls out of their bodies.

Episodes.Title: Cloud City of Gold
Episodes.Description: Peter is an exchange student in South America, flying in a charter airplane with a Latin American professor in the Andes mountains. The airplane encounters a violent storm and crashes in a jungle, and Peter changes to Spider-Man to assist the professor and the airplane's two pilots in leaving the jungle and returning to civilization.

Episodes.Title: Neptune's Nose Cone
Episodes.Description: On Jameson's orders, Peter, and Daily Bugle pilot, Penny Jones travel by small-engine airplane to the Antarctic Ocean to track a fallen nose cone and crash-land on an island with a superstitious, brutish, native population.

Episodes.Title: Home
Episodes.Description: At a coffee house, Peter meets Carol, a girl with whom he has much in common; he does not realize to what extent that they are alike until he, as Spider-Man, catches Carol in the act of robbing electrical equipment and finds that she has powers identical to his.

Episodes.Title: Blotto
Episodes.Description: Clive, an unbalanced movie producer, is determined to avenge himself upon critics and audiences who spurned his claim that the darkest human emotions could be filmed and physically released from a theatre screen.

Episodes.Title: Thunder Rumble
Episodes.Description: A giant Martian warrior, who throws lightning bolts, comes to Earth to rob the planet of its gold.

Episodes.Title: Spiderman Meets Skyboy
Episodes.Description: Dr. Irving Caldwell has devised a helmet capable of levitating its wearer and is kidnaped by a villainous scientist, Dr. Zap, who wants Caldwell's helmet to duplicate for his own evil use.

Episodes.Title: Cold Storage
Episodes.Description: Sophisticated diamond thief Dr. Cool and his henchman have heisted a fortune in diamonds and are at a deserted-before-dawn ice factory, planning to smuggle the gems through international customs by mixing the "hot ice" with large quantities of the ordinary variety.

Episodes.Title: To Cage a Spider
Episodes.Description: Two robbers dynamite a bank safe and abscond in their car with millions of stolen dollars.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: Doctor Strange
Episodes.Description: Peter discovers that Mary-Jane is working with a mysterious cult. Baron Mordo, head of the cult, wants them to steal the Wand of Watoom to free his master, Dormammu. When Mordo manages to get his hands on the wand, Spider-Man must team up with Doctor Strange and his sidekick Wong to stop them.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: Make a Wish (1)
Episodes.Description: Tired of Jameson giving Spider-Man the rap for all the crime in New York, Peter decides to give up the superhero business once and for all. However, his biggest fan, a little girl named Tyina, is determined to make Spider-Man change his mind.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: Attack of the Octobot (2)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man loses his memory and becomes partners in crime with Dr. Octopus.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: Enter the Green Goblin
Episodes.Description: Harry's father, Norman Osborn, disappears after an explosion at his chemical plant. Spider-Man's search for his friend's father, one way or another, meets with complications, namely an airborne fiend who calls himself the Green Goblin.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: Rocket Racer
Episodes.Description: While a gang of jet-pack wearing thieves run by Jackson Weele, an ex-pilot in a rampaging gyro-wheel, plunder the city, Peter tries to deal with his alter-ego giving him competition with Felicia Hardy. Meanwhile, a good kid with a criminal record, Robert Farrell, tries to help his ailing mother by using his science-savvy and the gang's technology to arm himself as the Rocket Racer. While Spider-Man's fighting crime, the mysterious "Jason Phillips" starts to make moves on Felicia.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: Framed
Episodes.Description: Peter is framed for a crime he didn't commit and it's up to blind lawyer Matt Murdock to prove his innocence, who is also known as the Man Without Fear, Daredevil.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: The Man Without Fear
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Daredevil manage to recover the disk that can clear Peter Parker's name. However, when Matt Murdock hands the disk over to the FBI, detective Terry Lee discovers agent Choi may not be working for the right side when she hands it over to Richard Fisk. After learning that Aunt May is in the hospital, Peter risks his life to go visit her, but he and Mary Jane are kidnapped when the Chameleon disguises himself as Anna Watson. With Peter and the disk in the hands of the Kingpin, Daredevil must stop the criminal mastermind and clear Peter's name.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: The Ultimate Slayer
Episodes.Description: Worried that the Kingpin is going to eliminate him after the botched framing of Peter Parker, Alistair Smythe arranges a meeting with Spider-Man to give him information about the Kingpin. When Spider-Man arrives, he discovers Smythe has been turned into a spider-slaying cyborg. However, when his programming malfunctions, he goes after the man he feels responsible for his father's death, Norman Osborn. Peter must fight a crazed Smythe, as well as his feelings, after he discovers Mary Jane, the woman he loves, and Harry, his best friend, are engaged.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: Tombstone
Episodes.Description: Robbie Robertson is losing his son, Randy, to a gang of thugs lead by Tombstone. When this harder-than-stone hitman tries to use his history with Robbie to kill a story about his new boss, Alicia Silvermane, he runs afoul of Spider-Man. Both discover Robbie's bond with his child and his ethical resolve is mightier.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: Venom Returns
Episodes.Description: Under the psychiatric care of Dr. Kafka, Eddie Brock has come to believe that Venom is a figment of his imagination. Then Baron Mordo tempts Eddie to a reunification with the alien symbote that makes him as powerful as Venom.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: Carnage
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Venom must put aside their differences and help Iron Man stop Carnage and Baron Mordo from releasing Dormammu.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: The Spot
Episodes.Description: Ex-employee of Stark Industries, Dr. Jonathan Ohn, invents a portable interdimensional technology that accidentally makes him the living embodiment of a portal. Calling himself the Spot, he tries to steal money to fund his research. But his unstable invention has created a vortex that threatens to engulf New York.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: Goblin War! (1)
Episodes.Description: When Dr. Ohn's Time Dilation Accelerator falls into the wrong hands, all the criminal minds of the city vie for the portal technology. Peter and Mary Jane are celebrating Felicia Hardy's engagement to Jason Macendale when they overhear plans for a major heist.

Episodes.Title: The Sins of the Fathers: Turning Point (2)
Episodes.Description: Peter Parker and Mary Jane are finally a couple, but their happiness is short-lived as the Green Goblin, armed with a Time Distorter and the true identity of Spider-Man, seeks to destroy the web-slinger by any means necessary.

Episodes.Title: The Winged Thing
Episodes.Description: Spidey discovers the bird-man Vulture robbing a millionaire's penthouse safe and unsuccessfully tries to stop the flying fiend.

Episodes.Title: Conner's Reptiles
Episodes.Description: Spidey swings to Florida again to battle a walking, thinking lizard. This time, the lizard is not a transformed Dr. Conner, but a reptile whose intelligence has been augmented in an experiment by Conner gone awry, and who has kidnaped Conner and holds the ill-fated scientist as captive at a Spanish fort.

Episodes.Title: Trouble With Snow
Episodes.Description: New York City children build a snowman with snow contaminated by trace chemicals from an industrial plant up the Hudson River, and a freak accident involving a broken electrical line hitting the snowman somehow brings the snowman to life.

Episodes.Title: Spiderman Vs. Desperado
Episodes.Description: Desperado, a cowboy criminal, lassos Spidey and begins a crime wave atop his electronic horse.

Episodes.Title: Sky Harbor
Episodes.Description: A German Baron utilizes a flying aircraft carrier to launch an attack on New York City with World War One-style fighter airplanes.

Episodes.Title: The Big Brainwasher
Episodes.Description: The Kingpin's latest scheme to control New York involves a machine that brainwashes city officials into doing as the commands.

Episodes.Title: The Vanishing Doctor Vespasian
Episodes.Description: Dr. Vespasian, a green-skinned, wrinkled scientist, concocts a drinkable invisibility formula and uses it on himself and his dog, Brutus.

Episodes.Title: The Scourge of the Scarf
Episodes.Description: From his vantage point atop a building, Spidey watches as crowds form long lines to attend Saturday night Broadway performances. To the panic of the mass of people, the Moon becomes a psychedelic pinwheel that fills the night sky and dizzies and renders everyone- including Spidey- unconscious.

Episodes.Title: Super Swami
Episodes.Description: Super Swami, an obese illusionist, seems to make the Brooklyn Bridge disappear piece by piece.

Episodes.Title: The Birth of Micro Man
Episodes.Description: Professor Pretories, the most diabolical mind ever known to science, escapes jail, and Peter unknowingly helps the convict by car-driving him, a hitchhiker, to his secret-laboratory hideout.

Episodes.Title: Knight Must Fall
Episodes.Description: Spidey jousts with a motorcycle-riding knight in armor who is robbing theatre box offices, armored trucks, and museum officials receiving a medieval artifact.

Episodes.Title: The Devious Dr. Dumpty
Episodes.Description: Dr. Dumpty, a corpulent jewel thief, attacks a parade with knock-out gas released from balloons, and he and his thugs, wearing gas masks, steal the jewels of actress Rachele Wells and abscond in a hot air balloon.

Episodes.Title: Up from Nowhere
Episodes.Description: The weird Dr. Atlantian rises out of the ocean near New York City in his hive-like machine, which derives its power from Lunar motion.

Episodes.Title: Rollarama
Episodes.Description: A remake of Season 2's "Vine", virtually identical in plot; the only difference is that instead of a giant plant threatening New York, the menace is a series of enormous, rolling pods that grow from boxes in a missing scientist's house.

Episodes.Title: Rhino
Episodes.Description: In a cheater story comprised of footage from both Rhino episodes from Season 1, the Rhino again steals gold shipments with which to build a 14 karat statue of himself.

Episodes.Title: The Madness of Mysterio
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man tussles once more with master-of-illusion Mysterio. This time, Mysterio causes Spidey to think that he has shrunk the web-swinger and placed him in a miniature amusement park.

Episodes.Title: Revolt in the Fifth Dimension
Episodes.Description: Luck, Suggestion and Determination must guide Spider-Man through this trip into the 5th dimension. Spider-Man finds himself face to face with The Skeletal Infinata.

Episodes.Title: Specialists and Slaves
Episodes.Description: An old enemy of Spidey's, a radiation specialist who once lifted Manhattan into the sky, has been released from jail and promptly revisits Manhattan's nuclear power plant, stuns the outdoor guards with his ray gun, and again commandeers the reactor.

Episodes.Title: Down to Earth
Episodes.Description: Jameson orders Peter to fly in an airplane with Daily Bugle pilot Osa Olsen to the North Pole to locate a fallen meteor with bizarre antennae, but a thunder-snowstorm cripples Parker and Olsen's airplane, and it crashes in a wasteland populated by a  tribe of savages.

Episodes.Title: Trip to Tomorrow
Episodes.Description: A bolt of lightning breaks Spidey's web, causing him to fall into a boxcar at a rail yard. In the boxcar, Spidey meets a young runaway who plans to ride a freight train out of New York City and become "the Caped Protector of Podunk".

Episodes.Title: Partners in Danger: Guilty
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man captures a gang of thieves, and it looks like Robbie Robertson is their leader. Peter Parker and J. Jonah Jameson must team up to try to clear Robbie's name. But while Jameson returns to the skills he had as an investigative reporter, Peter must keep him safe from Tombstone.

Episodes.Title: Partners in Danger: The Cat (1)
Episodes.Description: Doctor Octopus is blackmailing the mother of Felicia Hardy, and she begins to realize that her family has some dark secrets. Some snooping in the Daily Bugle files by Peter, and a confession by Anastasia Hardy, reveal that Felicia's father was really the Cat Burglar, a thief who got rich from the gains of an enormous heist. The Kingpin joins forces with Doc Ock to spring Hardy from jail, as Hardy holds the secret to the 1940s "Super Soldier" formula that created Captain America. To ensure the Cat Burglar's cooperation, the Kingpin kidnaps Felicia.

Episodes.Title: Partners in Danger: The Black Cat (2)
Episodes.Description: Felicia Hardy, now transformed into the Black Cat, is blackmailed into working for the Kingpin until he can replicate more of the "Super Soldier" serum.

Episodes.Title: Partners in Danger: The Return of Kraven
Episodes.Description: When a savage creature begins attacking people in New York, the Black Cat tries to convince Spider-Man that he needs her help to stop it. All clues point to the creature being Kraven the Hunter, but sleuthing by Debra Whitman, Flash Thompson, and the Black Cat solves the case. The beast, Calypso, is related to Kraven, but the Hunter wants to capture and cure her.

Episodes.Title: Partners in Danger: Partners
Episodes.Description: While settling in to her new role as a hero, the Black Cat is captured by Alistair Smythe, now working for Silvermane, who is trapped in the body of a baby. Smythe delivers Spider-Man an ultimatum: capture the Scorpion or the Vulture within 24 hours, or the Black Cat dies.

Episodes.Title: Partners in Danger: The Awakening (1)
Episodes.Description: Deborah Whitman has located Morbius, the Living Vampire, and brings him back to ESU to work on a cure. Just before leaving town, Felicia Hardy hears of this and uses the trip as an excuse to stay behind as the Black Cat. Together with Spider-Man and Whistler, she has to take on Herbert Landon and the Shocker in order to save Morbius from himself.

Episodes.Title: Partners in Danger: The Vampire Queen (2)
Episodes.Description: There's a new Vampire in town, but Morbius is getting all the blame. Just as Spider-Man, the Black Cat, Whistler and Morbius have the Vampire Queen trapped, Blade bursts in and prevents her destruction. His revelation sets the others against him, while the queen attempts to create an army of vampires. Meanwhile, Harry Osborn discovers Peter's spare Spider-Man mask.

Episodes.Title: Partners in Danger: The Return of the Green Goblin
Episodes.Description: Harry Osborn is haunted by dreams of his father, the Green Goblin, and Spider-Man. The Goblin visits him and guides him to the Goblin formula and weapons. Meanwhile, the Punisher promises Anna Watson that he will find Mary Jane, and on top of his list of suspects is Peter Parker.

Episodes.Title: Partners in Danger: The Haunting of Mary Jane Watson
Episodes.Description: Mary Jane is back, and she has got the lead role in a major film. But when filming starts, all hell breaks loose, and Mary Jane vanishes from the studio. Spider-Man must fight to ensure that he doesn't lose Mary Jane again, even if it means teaming up with Mysterio. And when it's all over, Peter has a secret to tell.

Episodes.Title: Partners in Danger: The Lizard King
Episodes.Description: Peter and Mary Jane get engaged. The happy couple goes to ask Dr. Connors if he'll give away the bride, not knowing that he's been fighting against the return of the Lizard. While they are talking to him, three more humanoid lizards attack and kidnap Dr. Connors. With the Lizard taking over and Spider-Man captured, Margaret Connors, Mary Jane Watson, and Debra Whitman will have to save the day.

Episodes.Title: Partners in Danger: The Prowler
Episodes.Description: Upon returning to his new apartment, Peter is confronted by the Prowler. Revealing himself to be Hobie Brown, he tells Peter that he knows about Peter's connection to Spiderman, and that somehow the Kingpin is involved in all this.

Episodes.Title: The Wedding
Episodes.Description: Peter and Mary Jane's big day arrives, but things aren't going to go to plan if Harry Osborn gets his way. With guests including Flash Thompson, Liz, Aunt May, Anna Watson, Felicia Hardy, J. Jonah Jameson, Robbie Robertson and Wilson Fisk, along with gate crashers including the Green Goblin, the Kingpin, Alistair Smythe, the Scorpion, the Black Cat, Herbert Landon, the Mega-Slayer, Norman Osborn, and an army of robot Goblin Warriors, it'll certainly be a day to remember.

Episodes.Title: Six Forgotten Warriors (1)
Episodes.Description: After a visit from an "old friend" of the family, Peter travels to Russia to investigate the mystery of his parents disappearance, and runs into some old friends.

Episodes.Title: Six Forgotten Warriors (2): Unclaimed Legacy
Episodes.Description: Still in Russia, Peter discovers that searching for clues to his family's past isn't easy when he has to battle the Insidious Six and the Red Skull.

Episodes.Title: Six Forgotten Warriors (3): Secrets of the Six
Episodes.Description: Robbie and Peter encounter an old professor who knows about the Six Forgotten Warriors.

Episodes.Title: Six Forgotten Warriors (4): The Six Fight Again
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and the Warriors join forces to stop the Kingpin from activating the doomsday device.

Episodes.Title: Six Forgotten Warriors (5): The Price of Heroism
Episodes.Description: Red Skull reveals his Doomsday Weapon, the powerful Electro.

Episodes.Title: The Return of Hydro-Man (1)
Episodes.Description: Mary Jane and Peter arrive in Niagara Falls for their postponed honeymoon, but it is soon interrupted when Hydro-Man returns and kidnaps Mary Jane.

Episodes.Title: The Return of Hydro-Man (2)
Episodes.Description: Peter is shocked by Mary Jane's new powers, so they seek Curt Connors' help in figuring everything out. Mary Jane tells them about a dream she's been having, which may be a clue to her disappearance. But Hydro-Man finds them and kidnaps her again.

Episodes.Title: Secret Wars (1): Arrival
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man is transported to an alien world, where he meets the Beyonder, a being who wants to see if good is stronger than evil. He then summons a group of the greatest villains from Earth to this world, telling Spider-Man to put together a group of heroes to fight them and save the planet.

Episodes.Title: Secret Wars (2): The Gauntlet of the Red Skull
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man summons the Black Cat from Earth, who despite her anger at being kidnapped, decides to help him fight the villains on the alien planet. The heroes must defeat the Red Skull, Doctor Octopus, and Alistair Smythe's robots while protecting a group of rebels, who are trying to take their planet back.

Episodes.Title: Secret Wars (3): Doom
Episodes.Description: Dr. Doom reverts the Thing to his human form and holds the other heroes prisoner. In an attempt to free his friends, the Thing tells Dr. Doom about the Beyonder. Dr. Doom then steals the Beyonder's powers, but they begin manifesting themselves in the form of creatures from Dr. Doom's dreams.

Episodes.Title: Spider Wars (1): I Really, Really Hate Clones
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man finds himself in yet another dimension, where he meets himself.

Episodes.Title: Spider Wars (2): Farewell, Spider-Man
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man is sent through several dimensions trying to fix time and seal away Spider-Carnage. Peter meets his would-be girlfriend Gwen Stacy and Stan Lee.

Entries.Title: Marvel's Spider-Man
Entries.Description: Peter is accepted into Horizon High: a school for geniuses, where his best friend Harry Osborn was just suspended. Peter makes his debut as Spider-Man and must battle the Vulture.

Episodes.Title: Horizon High (1)
Episodes.Description: Peter is accepted into Horizon High: a school for geniuses, where his best friend Harry Osborn was just suspended. Peter makes his debut as Spider-Man and must battle the Vulture.

Episodes.Title: Horizon High (2)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must work to stop the Scorpion from wreaking havoc at the museum.

Episodes.Title: Osborn Academy
Episodes.Description: Norman Osborn creates the Osborn Academy for Geniuses as a way of saving his son, Harry, the embarrassment of being suspended from Horizon High.

Episodes.Title: A Day in the Life
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must stop Black Cat from committing a spree of thefts while still keeping his school obligations.

Episodes.Title: Party Animals
Episodes.Description: Horizon High throws a dance in honor of Harry being exonerated, but Norman asks Harry to stay at the Oz Academy.

Episodes.Title: Sandman
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man meets the powerful, yet uncontrollable Sandman and helps him reunite with his estranged daughter with the help of the Venom symbiote.

Episodes.Title: Symbiotic Relationship
Episodes.Description: When Spider-Man uses his new black costume, he discovers that there is great danger in his new power; and he must find a way to defeat a costume that wants to destroy him.

Episodes.Title: Stark Expo
Episodes.Description: After the terror of the symbiote, Spidey is off to the Stark Expo in his old costume. When Ghost hijacks the event, Spidey's only chance to save lives is to unleash the symbiote.

Episodes.Title: Ultimate Spider-Man
Episodes.Description: When Miles Morales is bitten by an experimental spider and gains spider powers, Spider-Man must teach him the responsibilities of being a superhero.

Episodes.Title: Kraven's Amazing Hunt
Episodes.Description: Kraven the Hunter does a live broadcast of his hunt for Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: Halloween Moon
Episodes.Description: On Halloween night, Spider-Man must team up with the incredible Hulk to stop Man-Wolf, a super-strong gamma-powered werewolf, from infecting the rest of Manhattan.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Man on Ice
Episodes.Description: Spidey must stop a low-level villain who has acquired some impressive freezing technology.

Episodes.Title: Venom
Episodes.Description: The symbiote has escaped the Avengers Compound and attached itself to a new host. Now Spidey must find out how to beat it and who the new person is underneath.

Episodes.Title: Screwball Live
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man is targeted by a new costumed figure named Screwball for a series of online prank videos which block him from fighting crime.

Episodes.Title: The Rise of Doc Ock (1)
Episodes.Description: When Otto Octavius is caught in an explosion that fuses his robot arms to his body, Spider-Man sees the opportunity to recruit "The Octopus" into becoming a hero.

Episodes.Title: The Rise of Doc Ock (2)
Episodes.Description: Spidey invites The Octopus to patrol the streets alongside Miles and himself until it becomes clear that Otto isn't exactly a team player.

Episodes.Title: The Rise of Doc Ock (3)
Episodes.Description: Peter spends a day at Osborn Academy in the hopes of finding a clue that will convince Harry that his father is out to destroy Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: The Rise of Doc Ock (4)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must team up with Gwen Stacy and a reluctant Harry Osborn to investigate the truth behind the missing Raymond Warren aka the Jackal.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Island (1)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man tracks a new villain with spider powers who steals his experimental stealth suit and threatens the entire city.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Island (2)
Episodes.Description: Everyone in Manhattan manifests spider powers; Spider-Man and Spider-Gwen must help Black Widow track down Crossbones before he delivers the vibranium to Arnim Zola and Hydra.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Island (3)
Episodes.Description: Peter must find a way to cure Gwen Stacy and Norman Osborn after they turn into spider monsters; things get harder when Kraven the Hunter turns New York into his hunting grounds.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Island (4)
Episodes.Description: Peter and Harry must battle through an island of spider monsters to get to Norman Osborn, who appears to control them all; the boys discover the real mastermind.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Island (5)
Episodes.Description: To cure the spider-monster population of Manhattan, Spider-Man must lead Kid Arachnid, Anya and Harry on a desperate, last-ditch effort to stop the Jackal.

Episodes.Title: The Hobgoblin (1)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man takes on Doc Ock and his Sinister Five before they brainwash Spidey and destroy New York City.

Episodes.Title: The Hobgoblin (2)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must find a way to stop Hobgoblin, who seems completely bent on doing whatever it takes to destroy Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: How I Thwipped My Summer Vacation
Episodes.Description: Peter Parker struggles to balance the best summer vacation ever and his responsibilities as Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: Take Two
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man is excited to start his second year as a superhero and as a student at Horizon High, but discovers that Doc Ock also claims to want a second chance.

Episodes.Title: Between an Ock and a Hard Place
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man discovers there is a new Doctor Octopus taking up the mantle from Otto Octavius and finds himself drawn into this new mystery, missing the danger right under his nose.

Episodes.Title: Rise Above It All
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man has to infiltrate the viral superstars known as the Wake Riders in order to figure out what the end game is with their stolen Vulture tech. But things take a dangerous turn as Adrian Toomes is tempted back to the dark side.

Episodes.Title: School of Hard Knocks
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man teams up with Ms. Marvel to investigate an elite boarding school after its students start displaying out-of-control, super-powered behaviors.

Episodes.Title: Dead Man’s Party
Episodes.Description: Eddie Brock, who has emerged with the vengeance-filled Venom symbiote, sets his sights on destroying Peter Parker and everything that is Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: Venom Returns
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man is two steps behind as Venom kidnaps key figures in Peter Parker's life; demanding a face-off against Peter, Venom holds them hostage at Horizon High.

Episodes.Title: Bring on the Bad Guys (1)
Episodes.Description: A mystery villain puts a bounty on Spider-Man's head, bringing on attacks from Panda-Mania, Hippo and Overdrive.

Episodes.Title: Bring on the Bad Guys (2)
Episodes.Description: Anya must step up and embrace being the Spider-Girl; Spider-Man is lured into Mysterio's funhouse and learns that there is a bounty on his head.

Episodes.Title: Bring on the Bad Guys (3)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man faces off against his most bizarre bad guy yet, Jack O'Lantern; he turns Prowler, a reluctant villain, to the side of heroes when he helps him save his brother.

Episodes.Title: Bring on the Bad Guys (4)
Episodes.Description: Spidey tracks the identity of the mysterious boss that put a price on his head and who has been sending villains after him.

Episodes.Title: Brain Drain
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man and Miles Morales discover Doc Ock, whose mind has been hiding inside the metal body of the Living Brain, has been behind the mysterious bounty for Spider-Man’s head.

Episodes.Title: The Living Brain
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must fight his way through the Super-Villain Holding Facility to challenge the Living Brain, the robot body that houses the mind of Doctor Octopus.

Episodes.Title: The Day Without Spider-Man
Episodes.Description: The Bloodgem accidentally reawakens Gwen Stacy's dormant spider-powers, turning her into Ghost Spider!

Episodes.Title: My Own Worst Enemy
Episodes.Description: Doc Ock intends to bring New York to its knees, but his new brain still contains memories of Uncle Ben.

Episodes.Title: Critical Update
Episodes.Description: Doc Ock must adjust to his new life as a hero and is tested by rising crime boss Sand Girl.

Episodes.Title: A Troubled Mind
Episodes.Description: Superior Spider-Man is confronted by the Avengers who suspect that he is not who he claims to be.

Episodes.Title: Cloak and Dagger
Episodes.Description: When Cloak and Dagger emerge to take revenge against Tiberius Stone and his company, Alchemax, Superior Spider-Man must take them down to protect the school.

Episodes.Title: Superior
Episodes.Description: Superior Spider-Man must face his most challenging opponent when Venom escapes from stasis and attacks Midtown High seeking revenge on Peter Parker.

Episodes.Title: Brand New Day
Episodes.Description: A series of attacks captures the Avengers one-by-one. Spider-Man is left to figure out who is behind the kidnappings.

Episodes.Title: The Cellar
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man takes his mission to The Cellar, where he believes The Regent is using his powers of Cloak & Dagger as well as other supervillains to hold the Avengers captive.

Episodes.Title: The Road to Goblin War
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man has to take down the slick new villain, Slyde, who is stealing various chemicals from around the city in an effort to create a deadly virus that could wipe out New York.

Episodes.Title: Goblin War (1)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man must team up with Spider-Girl Ghost Spider, and Doc Ock to track down a new threat — the mysterious Goblin Nation.

Episodes.Title: Goblin War (2)
Episodes.Description: As Spider-Man and Harry Osborn seek the Goblin King to determine who is behind the Goblin Mask, Spider-Man becomes concerned Harry is leading him into trap.

Episodes.Title: Goblin War (3)
Episodes.Description: Peter Parker struggles with the duality of his social life at school and hiding his secret identity from everyone, including his best friend Harry Osborn

Episodes.Title: Goblin War (4)
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man, Miles Morales, Spider-Girl, Ghost Spider, Harry Osborn and Doc Ock must stop the Goblin King in his newly acquired Goblin Mech Suit before he destroys New York City.

Episodes.Title: Web of Venom
Episodes.Description: When Spider-Man and Max Modell experiment on a sample of Venom symbiote, it escapes and unleashes a weapon of unknown purpose.

Episodes.Title: Amazing Friends
Episodes.Description: When Toddler Groot lands on Earth to deliver an urgent warning, Spider-Man must decode the message and keep him out of the evil clutches of both A.I.M. and Baron Mordo.

Episodes.Title: Vengeance of Venom
Episodes.Description: Symbiotes from space send an advanced hunting party to Earth to take out all of the superheroes; Spider-Man must team up with Marc Spector and Max Modell to save the planet.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Man Unmasked
Episodes.Description: After Aleksei is turned back into the rampaging Rhino by Swarm, the Spider Team must battle for their lives in the Underground Monster League contest.

Episodes.Title: Generations
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man discovers Norman Osborn is responsible for the Venom Symbiote's escape; Norman, aka the Dark Goblin, brings the Generations team to battle against Spider-Man.

Episodes.Title: Maximum Venom
Episodes.Description: When Spider-Man and his allies attempt to track down the missing and dangerous Lizard, they discover that Venom has returned to seek revenge on the earth.

Entries.Title: The Flash
Entries.Description: Barry discovers his powers and puts them to the test, only when he finds its no longer a test but the real thing when he encounters a certain someone.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Barry discovers his powers and puts them to the test, only when he finds its no longer a test but the real thing when he encounters a certain someone.

Episodes.Title: Fastest Man Alive
Episodes.Description: Barry changes into the Flash when six gunmen storm a university event honoring a scientist, but his heroics don't match up to his expectations. Meanwhile, Iris becomes even more intrigued by the "red streak."

Episodes.Title: Things You Can't Outrun
Episodes.Description: Barry and the team go after the Mist, who possesses toxic gas powers, and they reflect on the night Caitlin's fiancé died. Meanwhile, Henry gets a long-awaited visit from Joe, and Iris and Eddie continue to keep their romance a secret from Joe.

Episodes.Title: Going Rogue
Episodes.Description: The Flash battles Captain Cold after the villain is involved in a robbery and plots to steal the Kahndaq Dynasty Diamond.

Episodes.Title: Plastique
Episodes.Description: After a bomb explodes downtown, the army rolls in and takes over. When Joe learns Iris is writing about 'The Streak' and tries unsuccessfully to have the story stopped, Barry decides to have The Flash pay her a visit.

Episodes.Title: The Flash is Born
Episodes.Description: The Flash faces a new meta-human named Tony, who can turn himself into girded steel at will.

Episodes.Title: Power Outage
Episodes.Description: The Flash goes up against Farooq aka Blackout, a metahuman who can harness electricity.

Episodes.Title: Flash vs. Arrow (I)
Episodes.Description:
Barry is thrilled when Oliver, Felicity and Diggle come to Central City to investigate a case involving a deadly boomerang.

The crossover continues on Arrow S03E08 The Brave and the Bold.

Episodes.Title: The Man in the Yellow Suit
Episodes.Description: Barry enjoys the annual tradition of tree trimming and gift exchange with Joe and Iris. He gives Iris a touching gift, but the moment is interrupted by Eddie’s arrival.

Episodes.Title: Revenge of the Rogues
Episodes.Description: While Barry strives to become fast enough to defeat Reverse-Flash, Captain Cold returns to Central City with a partner and takes Caitlin hostage to force a confrontation with the Flash.

Episodes.Title: The Sound and the Fury
Episodes.Description: Dr. Wells' former protégé, Hartley Rathaway, returns to seek revenge on his mentor. Meanwhile, Iris is hired as a cub reporter; Cisco recalls his first day on the job at S.T.A.R. Labs; and Joe asks Eddie for a favor but asks him to keep it a secret from Barry.

Episodes.Title: Crazy for You
Episodes.Description: Caitlin takes Barry out to a local karaoke bar to help them both find new loves. Caitlin strikes out but Barry meets a sports reporter and asks her out for a date. Meanwhile, Cisco considers Hartley's dangerous offer; and the team search for Shawna, a meta-human with teleportation powers who just busted her boyfriend out of Iron Heights.

Episodes.Title: The Nuclear Man
Episodes.Description: While Barry, Harrison, and Caitlin hunt down Ronnie, who has attacked a man, Joe recruits Cisco to help him learn the truth about who murdered Nora Allen.

Episodes.Title: Fallout
Episodes.Description: Martin and Ronnie are separated, only to realize that they must learn how to rejoin before Eiling hunts them down and kills them... and the Flash. Meanwhile, Joe shows Barry the 3D images from the Nora Allen crime scene, and Barry asks Martin for advice on time travel.

Episodes.Title: Out of Time
Episodes.Description: Mark Mardon, having survived his apparent death during the black-matter explosion, returns seeking revenge on Joe for the death of his brother Clyde... and has the same weather-manipulation powers as his deceased sibling.

Episodes.Title: Rogue Time
Episodes.Description: The Flash learns that Captain Cold and Heat Wave have returned to Central City. This time Snart has brought along his baby sister Lisa to help wreak havoc on the city.

Episodes.Title: Tricksters
Episodes.Description: When a villain calling himself the Trickster runs rampant in Central City, Joe and Barry go to Iron Heights to talk with the original Trickster.

Episodes.Title: All Star Team Up
Episodes.Description: Felicity and Ray Palmer pay a visit to S.T.A.R. Labs for help getting Ray's ATOM suit to work, and ask Cisco for help. Meanwhile, a young tech expert raises havoc with her insect drones, and Barry asks Ray for help dealing with her.

Episodes.Title: Who Is Harrison Wells?
Episodes.Description: Joe and Cisco go to Starling City to ask Quentin Lance for his help investigating the site of Harrison's car accident 15 years ago and determining what really happened. Meanwhile, Eddie is framed for a shooting by a shapeshifing metahuman who can take on the appearance of anyone he touches.

Episodes.Title: The Trap
Episodes.Description: Barry, Caitlin, Cisco and Joe set a trap for Wells. Cisco uses himself as prey which puts him in grave danger. Meanwhile, Eddie makes a decision regarding Iris, which leaves Joe a bit unsettled.

Episodes.Title: Grodd Lives
Episodes.Description: While Barry tries to find Eddie, a mysterious mind-controlled thief launches attacks on Central City's gold reserves. The team soon discovers that a telepathic gorilla is behind the robberies... and is following Harrison's commands. Meanwhile, Iris confronts Barry, while Harrison prepares to return home.

Episodes.Title: Rogue Air
Episodes.Description: When Harrison activates the particle accelerator, the team has no choice but to evacuate the five metahuman prisoners. Unfortunately, with time running out, Barry has no choice but to turn to Captain Cold for help. Meanwhile, Eddie escapes but has some surprising news for Iris.

Episodes.Title: Fast Enough
Episodes.Description: Wells presents Barry with a life-changing choice. Dr. Martin Stein and Ronnie Raymond return to help the S.T.A.R. Labs team with this final fight.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Saved Central City
Episodes.Description: Picking up months after the Singularity attacked Central City, Barry is still struggling to forgive himself for Eddie’s death. Concerned about putting his friends in danger, Barry has pushed everyone away and has chosen to protect the city on his own. When a meta-human named Atom Smasher attacks the city, Iris tells Barry that he needs to let his friends help him protect the citizens of Central City. Meanwhile, Cisco helps Joe with his Meta Task Force.

Episodes.Title: Flash of Two Worlds
Episodes.Description: Jay Garrick, a mysterious man from Earth-2, appears at S.T.A.R. Labs with a dire warning about an evil speedster named Zoom, who is set on destroying The Flash. Barry and the team must decide if they can trust this stranger even as they face yet another powerful meta-human. Meanwhile, Joe must deal with a determined officer named Patty Spivot who wants to join his meta-human task force.

Episodes.Title: Family of Rogues
Episodes.Description: When Barry and the team find out Captain Cold has been kidnapped, they form an uneasy alliance with his sister, Lisa. However, Barry feels double-crossed when he finds out Snart is working with his father, Lewis Snart on a heist. Meanwhile, Joe is faced with a difficult decision.

Episodes.Title: The Fury of Firestorm
Episodes.Description: Barry and the team look for another Firestorm match for Dr. Stein. When the team meets Jefferson "Jax" Jackson, Caitlin has her reservations about whether Jax is the right match for Dr. Stein. Iris surprises Joe while Barry and Patty grow closer.

Episodes.Title: The Darkness and the Light
Episodes.Description: Barry learns a new breacher, Dr. Light, has come through the portal and sets off to capture her. Jay tells Barry that Dr. Light was not a threat on Earth-2 and that Barry can reason with her. However, during a fight with The Flash, she blinds him and drops some shocking news about Zoom. Meanwhile, Barry and Patty go out on a date.

Episodes.Title: Enter Zoom
Episodes.Description: After recent events, Barry decides it’s time to confront Zoom and comes up with a dangerous plan. Caitlin sides with Jay and deems it too dangerous for Barry to engage with the speed demon. However, Iris shows her support and brings forth a surprising ally. We see what Earth-2 Harrison Wells’ life was like before coming through the breech.

Episodes.Title: Gorilla Warfare
Episodes.Description: Grodd returns to Central City and kidnaps Caitlin. Barry and team race to find her before it’s too late. Meanwhile, Cisco plans his first date with the new barista at Jitters, Kendra Saunders and Patty begins to suspect Barry is hiding something from her.

Episodes.Title: Legends of Today (I)
Episodes.Description:
Vandal Savage arrives in Central City and sets his sights on Kendra Saunders. After Vandal attacks Kendra and Cisco, they turn to Barry for help. Realizing how dangerous Vandal is, Barry takes Kendra to Star City and asks Oliver and team to hide her until he can figure out how to stop Vandal. However, things quickly go from bad to worse when a man with wings AKA Hawkman shows up and flies off with Kendra. Meanwhile, Harrison develops a serum to make Barry run faster and asks Jay to test it out.

The crossover continues on Arrow S04E08 Legends of Yesterday (II).

Episodes.Title: Running to Stand Still
Episodes.Description: When Mark Mardon AKA The Weather Wizard returns to break Leonard Snart AKA Captain Cold and James Jesse AKA The Trickster out of Iron Heights, Barry must stop these rogues from taking over Central City during Christmas. Meanwhile, Joe and Iris meet Wally West.

Episodes.Title: Potential Energy
Episodes.Description: Now that they've grown closer, Barry considers telling Patty that he is The Flash. Meanwhile, Joe and Iris try to get to know Wally, and the team hunts down a meta-human who can slow time itself.

Episodes.Title: The Reverse-Flash Returns
Episodes.Description: When Cisco gets a vibe of Eobard Thawne, Barry and the team don’t believe it. But, after an attack at Mercury Labs, Christina McGee confirms that the Reverse Flash is back. Meanwhile, Iris and Francine share a nice moment that brings Iris closer to her brother, Wally.

Episodes.Title: Fast Lane
Episodes.Description: Barry teams up with Wells to figure out a way to close the breaches, but they are distracted by a meta-human nicknamed Tar Pit who can transform into liquid asphalt. Iris is concerned for Wally’s safety after she finds out about his drag racing hobby. When he refuses to stop she makes a bold move that puts her in danger.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Earth-2
Episodes.Description: Barry, Wells and Cisco journey to Earth-2 to rescue Wells’ daughter, Jesse from Zoom. Barry is stunned when he runs into Earth-2 Iris and Joe, but nothing prepares him for meeting Killer Frost and Deathstorm. Meanwhile, back on Earth-1, Jay has to take over the Flash’s responsibilities when a meta-human nicknamed Geomancer attacks Central City.

Episodes.Title: Escape from Earth-2
Episodes.Description: On Earth-2, the team races to find Zoom's lair and asks for help from the most unexpected source. Meanwhile, back on Earth-1, Caitlin rushes to perfect Velocity-9 so that Jay can stop the Geomancer.

Episodes.Title: King Shark
Episodes.Description: When King Shark escapes from an A.R.G.U.S. holding tank, Lyla and Diggle travel to Central City to warn The Flash. King Shark shows up at the West house and attacks Joe, Iris, Wally and Barry.

Episodes.Title: Trajectory
Episodes.Description: Having arrived in town intent on creating maximum chaos, Trajectory's antics are misinterpreted as having been perpetrated by the Flash himself. Barry thus must quickly uncover the mystery of who is the girl under the mask — as well as what is driving her mad desire for speed and destruction.

Episodes.Title: Flash Back
Episodes.Description: After the shocking revelation that Zoom is Jay Garrick, Barry is more determined than ever to get back to Earth-2 to stop Zoom forever. Desperate to find a way to increase his speed, Barry decides to travel back in time and masquerade as his earlier self in order to get his arch-nemesis, Dr. Harrison Wells/Eobard Thawne, to teach him how to run faster. However, things don’t go as planned and Barry is stunned to face familiar foe Hartley Rathaway, as well as old friend Eddie Thawne. Iris makes peace with her past in order to embrace her future.

Episodes.Title: Versus Zoom
Episodes.Description: Equipped with the tachyon device, Barry believes he is fast enough to stop Zoom and wants to open the breaches to catch him. Harry strongly advises against that plan but after Barry convinces him, Harry reveals that Cisco has the power to re-open the breach. Meanwhile, Hunter Zoloman’s painful story on Earth-2 is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Back to Normal
Episodes.Description: A meta-human with super strength named Griffin Grey mistakes Harry for Earth-1 Harrison Wells and kidnaps him, demanding that Wells cure him from his current condition. Realizing another brilliant Wells could help track Griffin’s location, Barry asks Jesse to help. Meanwhile, Wally corners Joe about The Flash.

Episodes.Title: Rupture
Episodes.Description: Zoom arrives back on Earth-1 intent on taking over Central City. Barry and Wells come up with a plan to stop Zoom once and for all but it’s extremely dangerous. Unsure if he should take the risk, Barry reaches out to both fathers for advice. Henry is adamantly opposed to Barry risking his life again but Joe thinks he can handle it which puts the two men at odds with each other. Meanwhile, Cisco is shocked when he vibes the Earth-2 villain Rupture, who happens to be his brother Dante’s doppelganger. Rupture came to this Earth seeking justice for Reverb’s death. Iris decides she’s finally ready to open up to Barry about her feelings for him.

Episodes.Title: The Runaway Dinosaur
Episodes.Description: With Barry gone, the team must figure out a way to handle the return of an old enemy - Girder. Realizing Girder is retracing his steps from his last attack, Iris volunteers to act as bait to trap him in S.T.A.R. Labs. Meanwhile, Barry fights to return to his old life.

Episodes.Title: Invincible
Episodes.Description: After Zoom unleashes an army of Earth-2 meta-humans on Central City, Barry is shaken when he sees their leader is the Black Canary’s Earth-2 doppelganger, the Black Siren. Meanwhile, Wally takes to the streets to help The Flash stop the meta-humans, which worries Joe. Iris and Henry are concerned about Barry taking on Zoom.

Episodes.Title: The Race of His Life
Episodes.Description: After Zoom reveals his true plan, Barry vows to do whatever it takes to stop him.

Episodes.Title: Flashpoint
Episodes.Description: Barry is living his dream life – his parents are alive, he’s asked Iris West on a date and he can finally be a normal guy as Central City has another speedster, Kid Flash, running around saving the city. When Barry starts forgetting parts of his old life, the Reverse Flash taunts his nemesis and tells him that there will be serious repercussions for Barry and the ones he loves if he continues to live in this alternate universe. In addition to losing his memories, his powers will also start to fade. When disaster strikes, Barry must decide if he wants to continue to live in this world as Barry Allen or return to his universe as The Flash.

Episodes.Title: Paradox
Episodes.Description: Barry realizes the effects from Flashpoint are much greater than he thought. Meanwhile, Barry meets new co-worker Julian Albert and is surprised by Julian's immediate disdain for him.

Episodes.Title: Magenta
Episodes.Description: Barry and Team Flash are thrilled to reunite with Earth-2  Wells and Jesse.  Wells  confides to Barry and Caitlin that Jesse has all  the powers of a speedster and has been saving people on his Earth.  He  is concerned about her safety and wants them to talk her out of using  her powers.  Meanwhile, Magenta, a new meta who  can control metal, terrorizes the city.

Episodes.Title: The New Rogues
Episodes.Description: Barry continues to train Jesse and when a new meta human, Mirror Master, appears on the scene he lets her tag along. Mirror Master has teamed up with his old partner, Top, and is looking for Snart to even a score. Jesse is quick to join the chase but defies one of Barry’s orders which results in disastrous consequences.

Episodes.Title: Monster
Episodes.Description: Caitlin goes to her mother to help understand the meta-human powers growing inside her. Meanwhile Barry tries to convince Julian to allow him to help investigate a new human meta-attack on Central City.

Episodes.Title: Shade
Episodes.Description: When Wally starts having dreams about being Kid Flash, Barry realizes he has to tell Wally, Iris and Joe about what happened to Wally in Flashpoint in order to keep him safe.

Episodes.Title: Killer Frost
Episodes.Description: Caitlin uses her powers to save Barry but as her mother predicted, the effort unleashes her inner Killer Frost. Killer Frost goes on a rampage looking for Dr. Alchemy, kidnapping Julian and battling both The Flash and Vibe. Meanwhile, Joe and H.R. have a heart to heart talk.

Episodes.Title: Invasion! (II)
Episodes.Description:
When aliens called the Dominators attack Central City, Barry speeds over to Star City to ask the Green Arrow for help in stopping them. Realizing the battle against the Dominators is bigger than they thought, they track down the Legends of Tomorrow, and Barry and Cisco create a breach to bring back a secret weapon – Supergirl. Once all of the super friends are assembled, they come up with a plan to attack but a shocking secret related to Flashpoint is revealed and suddenly no one is sure who they can trust. Meanwhile, Wally wants to join the battle against the aliens but Iris tells him he’s not ready.

The crossover starts on Supergirl S02E08 Medusa (I). It continues on Arrow S05E08 Invasion! (III) and DC's Legends of Tomorrow S02E07 Invasion! (IV).

Episodes.Title: The Present
Episodes.Description: With Alchemy and Savitar still looming threats, Barry is unable to focus on the Christmas holiday, and especially his relationship with Iris. Determined to stop Savitar, Barry goes to Earth-3 to get advice from Jay Garrick. Wally wants to help Barry fight Savitar and reveals that he’s been training with H.R, which doesn’t go over well with Barry. As Cisco faces his first Christmas without his brother Dante, old wounds are reopened.

Episodes.Title: Borrowing Problems from the Future
Episodes.Description: Barry is tormented by his vision of the future where Iris is murdered by Savitar. When a criminal named Plunder shows up in Central City, Barry recalls the villain’s presence in his vision of the future and fears that if he catches Plunder, it will cement Iris’ fate. Confused about Barry’s hesitation to stop Plunder, Wally decides to step in as Kid Flash. Caitlin offers Julian a job.

Episodes.Title: Dead or Alive
Episodes.Description: H.R.'s past catches up with him when a bounty hunter with vibe powers named Gypsy arrives in Central City to bring him back to Earth-19 to stand trial for his crime. It turns out inter-dimensional travel is illegal on their Earth. H.R. surrenders but when Barry and Cisco find out that H.R.’s only hope would be to challenge Gypsy to a fight to the death, they intercede and Cisco offers to fight Gypsy instead.

Episodes.Title: Untouchable
Episodes.Description: Barry and the team at S.T.A.R. Labs work together to bring down Clive Yorkin, a criminal meta-human who is methodically killing people by causing them to decompose at an accelerated rate. Joe becomes his next target but it’s Iris who is caught in the crossfire. The Flash mentors Kid Flash and begins to elevate the newer speedster’s training to another level.

Episodes.Title: Attack on Gorilla City (1)
Episodes.Description: When Jesse Quick informs the team that her father has been abducted, Barry, Caitlin, Cisco and Julian voyage to Earth-2 on a rescue mission to save Harry from Gorilla City. As they trek through the forest, Barry and the team are immediately captured and brought to Grodd. Grodd tells them he needs their help to stop Solovar, the leader of Gorilla City, as Solovar wants to invade Earth-1. Meanwhile, back on Earth-1, Jesse and Kid Flash hit the streets to stop a metahuman that can control gravity, with H.R. and Joe guiding them from S.T.A.R. Labs.
